quote.text: My balance says I have money but a bill is coming

promise.text: Available vs current balance: which one can you spend?

lines.text: Current balance counts what has posted.
Available balance also subtracts holds and pending items.
Neither one knows about the bills still coming.

eyebrow.text: How to read your two numbers today

head.text: Open the account and find both figures.

body.text: If your app shows only one, look for a label such as "available" or "posted", or check the ATM receipt.

eyebrow.text: How to read your two numbers today

head.text: Look at the pending list and add up anything marked as a hold or pre-authorization, especially fuel, hotels and rental cars.

eyebrow.text: How to read your two numbers today

body.text: If any is a check, find the date your bank says the money is released.
The notice you got when you deposited it lists that date.

eyebrow.text: How to read your two numbers today

head.text: Read your account agreement or ask the bank once whether the available figure includes an overdraft line.

body.text: It changes how you read every balance afterward.

eyebrow.text: How to read your two numbers today

head.text: Subtract what is due before payday from the available figure.

line.text: Bills you protect are held back whether they are paid yet or not, so the figure never counts money you already owe.
